text:
Of all cuantos anhelan your presencia
as a mañana,
Of all cuantos padecen your ausencia
as a night,
As the destierro inapelable of the sol sacred
Allende the firmamento; of all the dolientes that a cada instante
You bendicen for the esperanza, for the life, ah,
and over all,
For haberles devuelto the fe extraviada, enterrada
In the truth, in the virtud, in the raza of the man…


Of all aquellos that, when agonizaban
in the lecho impío
Of the desesperanza, is han incorporado of pronto
To the oírte susurrar with dulzura: “¡That haya light!”,
To the oírte susurrar esas words acentuadas
For the sereno brillo of your eyes…


Of all your numerosos deudores,
cuya gratitud
Raya the veneración, recuerda, oh,
not olvides nunca
A your devoto more ferviente, to the more incondicional,
And piensa that estas líneas vacilantes
the habrá escrito él,
Ese that now, to the escribirlas,
is emociona pensando
That his espíritu comulga with the espíritu
of a ángel.

translation.title: Of all cuantos anhelan your presencia
